lines.t: Grey walls and empty words
Static in my veins
I'm drowning in silence
Suffocating chains
Wake up cold again
A dull ache in my chest, I wanna rip through the numbness
Find a reason for this mess
Lost in self and sorrow, strange echo in the night
I'm pacing through the shadows, a craving out of sight
Break me open, let the rivers run
Crash the stone I'm made of me
Burn and break and tear it down
So love can set me free
If there's more than empty noise
And peace behind the pain
Reveal the depths I couldn't feel
And flood me like the rain
Thought I knew devotion
But fear became my king
Afraid to lose control
Afraid of what love brings
But somewhere in the haunting
A whisper won't let go
It's calling me to weakness
To give in and be known
Uneasy with surrender
But nothing else remains
Desperate for deliverance
From all these stubborn chains
Break me open, let the rivers run
Crash the stone I'm made of me
Burning, breaking, tearing down
So love can set me free
Every scar and every doubt
Twisting in the dark
Reveal what I was made to hold
Ignite a rebel spark
Stripped of every idol, my defiance burning out
A hunger shakes the silence, revelation wears me down
Each wound becomes a window, every tear a door
Until the walls collapse and I'm not me anymore
Break me open, let the rivers run
Wash away the bitter years, let me disappear in love
United never fear, now I'll breathe your fire in me
The battle finally done, undone, awakened, joined as one
Forever with the sun
Thank you.
